title: Audit Record Schema
description: JSON Schema for the textual (JSON) encoding of one RFC-0001 §5.6 audit-log record (familiar-contract v0.7 subset). Covers the seven event types named in §5.6 and enforces the §5.6.1 canonical encodings: hash-bearing fields are 64-character lowercase bare hexadecimal, never algorithm-prefixed strings; the hash algorithm is fixed by each field's definition (ward_hash: BLAKE3; diff_hash, entry_hash: SHA-256), so no discriminator field appears here. The record root remains open to implementation-specific extension fields, which conformance checking ignores; implementation-specific extension event types are outside this schema's scope. Runtime obligations (append-only behavior, recomputation as tamper evidence, fail-closed rejection of unsupported algorithms, referent resolution) are normative in §5.6/§5.6.1 and are not expressible here.

event_id.description: Unique identifier of this audit-log entry.

proposal_id.description: Present when the event is proposal-related (§5.6).

familiar_id.description: The familiar whose surfaces this event concerns.

ward_version.description: Ward manifest version; with ward_hash, identifies a committed Ward state (§1.1). MUST for ward_updated events.

ward_hash.description: BLAKE3 structural commitment to the committed authority state, per the §5.6.1 domain-tagged Merkle construction. MUST for ward_updated events.

tier.description: Approval tier of the proposal, when proposal-related (§5.3).

decision.description: The decision recorded by this event.

approver.description: Identity of the approving party, when applicable.

diff_hash.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the exact post-write surface bytes (§5.6.1). Populated on apply events; MAY be null on proposal-verdict events.

files_touched.description: Surfaces touched by the audited action.

entry_hash.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the admitted memory entry's canonical bytes — the exact UTF-8 byte sequence appended to the memory surface (§5.6.1). MUST for memory_entry_admitted events.

source_attestation.description: Identifies the prior committed Ward state or principal-authorized write event justifying admission; MUST resolve in the append-only audit log (§5.6). MUST for memory_entry_admitted events.

principal_authorization.description: Explicit principal authorization evidence. MUST for ward_updated and principal_authorized_write events, and for memory_entry_admitted events recording a loop-originated entry (§3.4, §5.6).

hashHex.description: Textual hash encoding per §5.6.1: exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters (a raw 32-byte value), bare — no sha256:/blake3: prefix, no uppercase. The algorithm is fixed by the field's definition.
